title: The Komfortkasse for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.4.9 does not properly validate the authenticity of REST API…
description: The Komfortkasse for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions prior to 1.4.9 improperly validate REST API request authenticity by overriding WordPress's nonce verification. This flaw allows a request forged in a logged-in administrator's browser to be accepted, enabling an attacker to create a new administrator account and fully take over the site.
